review_rules: Creation myths are cultural/theological evidence unless the source supplies independently observable events.
Do not collapse Anu, Anuiel, Padomay and Sithis into universal one-to-one identities without source-specific evidence.
Lorkhan, Shor, Shezarr and Lorkhaj correspondences must preserve cultural framing and differences.
Developer metaphysical explanation is tagged separately from in-character cosmology.
Track whether terminology first appears in released material, developer material or later community synthesis.
